title: Riverbank Explorer A-Z
hook: Step by step, bend by bend.
Find a word, then walk again.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: warm 3D riverbank explorer storybook, golden afternoon light, river blues, natural greens, clear toy-like subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: riverbank explorer taking small observational steps
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: step-and-name hook with clean natural rhyme
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written riverbank ballad quatrains; second and fourth lines usually answer in rhyme or near-rhyme while first and third lines carry free narrative, with form broken whenever fact or pronunciation needs room
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: one-beat cue gap and a compact gesture; no generic tale/point formula
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 guitar/shaker walking pulse; chorus adds glockenspiel; Round 2 strips to stomps and bass
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: two soft footstep taps before every new section
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make the alphabet a real riverbank walk: each letter is something the child notices by taking another step, and the repeated bend-by-bend motion turns observation into memory.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Walking verbs and trail geography lead—step, bend, bank, pass, pause, follow, cross, look back. Ballad rhyme appears mainly as a walking cadence, while concrete observations keep the narrator grounded in the path.
semanticArc: longer look across water and valley
steps slow and the walk becomes a remembered A-to-Z trail
